name: DynamoDbGetMany
label: Get Many AWS DynamoDB Items
description: Retrieves multiple items from AWS DynamoDB using Query or Scan API.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name or ID
fields.description: The name of the DynamoDB table to retrieve items from.

fields.name: Scan
fields.label: Scan
fields.description: If enabled, performs a full table scan instead of a query.

fields.name: KeyConditionExpression
fields.label: Key Condition Expression
fields.description: The condition expression for querying items (e.g., 'id = :id').

fields.name: FilterExpression
fields.label: Filter Expression
fields.description: The filter expression to apply after scanning (e.g., 'status = 'active'').

fields.name: ExpressionAttributeValues
fields.label: Expression Attribute Values
fields.description: Values for placeholders in condition or filter expressions.

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all items (with pagination). Otherwise, limits results by 'Limit'.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (max 100). Default: 50.

fields.name: Simplify
fields.label: Simplify
fields.description: If enabled, returns only the key values of the retrieved items.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the DynamoDB table is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS DynamoDB.
